description: A team of curious minds and different skills.
summary:
NOVA SPACE is a web-based health management tool. Users can enter or upload values for 33 different health markers across 11 categories. Categories include cardiovascular, respiratory, cognition, sleep, stress, physical performance, radiation, immune markers, environment, bone and vision. Users will be able to view an interactive body graphic and trend graphs showing how they are performing against a clinical approved baseline for each category.

The tool uses a transparent rules engine to highlight if new data hits any thresholds set by the medical team. Data is colour coded using an easy to understand traffic light system giving users information as to why a value has been highlighted. Any highlighted items will then be passed onto clinicians. Any data that is pending or missing will never be considered as normal. There is also a game included to keep astronauts engaged with their prescribed mission.

This solves the problem by transforming random data into early alerts with explanations. This is important as astronauts will not have access to doctors for long duration missions. Small changes in radiation, bone, vision or sleep could cause serious issues if not picked up quickly.
details:
What it does and how it works

NOVA SPACE is a browser-based health monitoring tool for astronauts. It provides decision-making support for astronauts by allowing crew members to manually input or import data from CSV/JSON documents. There are 33 variables monitored across 11 categories. 18 variables were taken from the ASTRA Health Monitoring document in the following categories; cardiovascular, respiratory, cognitive, mood/stress/sleep, physical and general. Additional variables were included in the tool to help monitor risk factors associated with spaceflight which were; radiation, immune markers, cabin environment, bone and vision.

Every variable has been compared to an agreed baseline by clinicians using a clear rule engine. This then assigns each variable with a colour, along with the specific rule and evidence to back this up. When serious flags are raised these are passed to clinicians to make a decision, this will be recorded in an audit history. Data that is not fully defined will never be marked as normal. Any issues with imported data will be reported. An interactive body map and trends have been added to show where variables are changing. A game has been added to encourage users to follow the agreed plan to recover by rewarding them with XP, levels and badges.

Benefits and impact

Early warning system with clear reasoning behind it. For example, if heart rate is increasing and sleep is decreasing.

Less reliance on medical support on the ground. Long missions have communication issues.

Improved compliance to prevention/exercise plan with game.

Technology

The application has been created using HTML, CSS & vanilla JavaScript. No frameworks were used. The body map and trends have been created using SVG. Passwords are hashed using PBKDF2 (part of Web Crypto API) and data within the browser is encrypted using AES-GCM (part of Web Crypto API). Data is stored in IndexedDB and local storage. Fonts have been taken from Google Fonts; IBM Plex Sans & Rajdhani. No hardware was used or sensors connected. All data within the demo has been marked as SIMULATED. (Include any AI assistants or design tools used by your team.)

Creativity

Variables have been assigned colours based on agreed thresholds set by clinicians.

Associations between variables have been made clear. For example, if strength is low then exercise compliance will also be low. Or CO₂ in the cabin will be linked to symptoms. These will not be diagnosed.

Radiation dose will only ever be calculated by adding the dosimeter readings, they will never be estimated from other vitals.

A body map dashboard allows the user to easily understand the data.

Considerations

Educational tool - Not a diagnosis or prescription.

Units have been checked. Incomplete records will not be used in calculations.

Lab, scans and vision tests do not happen every day.

Data will not leave the device as it is encrypted.

Light colours used to make it easy on the eye. Keyboard focus, reduced motion and an inbuilt guide have been included.
